title: Ritualist collector armor
wikitext:
[[Collector]]s offer armor pieces in exchange for [[Trophy|trophies]]. Click on the name of the trophy to find out the collector's location.

Note that only pieces with less than 60 armor rating will provide an empty insignia slot.
